Art & Design in Amsterdam this week

16 – 22 Nov · 18 events

Temporary exhibitions, open studios, art fairs, gallery openings and design pop-ups across the city. Whether you collect, make art yourself or just like to look, they are an easy way to see new work up close and meet the people behind it. The list is refreshed every week. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.
